shared_elements: horizontal band or register of carving
bird or bird-like figure in profile
repeated carved signs or small motifs
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both surfaces use shallow carving on an upright stone face with horizontal zones containing repeated signs, including profile figures and disc/oval motifs. The biggest difference is that A is densely organized into many fine, text-like registers with small standardized figures, while B has a few large, rougher, widely spaced relief forms on an irregular architectural surface.
